newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: PSC Industries stock up on requotation.
newsitem.headline: PSC Industries stock up on requotation.

text.p: The stock of PSC Industries Bhd rose 4.8 percent on requotation on Wednesday after a four-week suspension, dealers said.
About five minutes into trading, the stock was up 1.50 ringgit to 32.75 ringgit on volume of 300,000 shares.
Shipbuilder and marine firm PSC Industries on Monday announced a proposal to raise its shareholding in Naval Dockyard Sdn Bhd to 58 percent through various acquisitions.
It now holds 28 percent equity in the dockyard and had proposed in December to raise its stake to 44 percent through a subsidiary.
